smokeTestNotes: Product and pricing pages reviewed in October 2026.
name: Cedreo
shortDescription: Home design with photoreal interior and exterior renderings. Plans from $129 a month.
longDescription: Cedreo is cloud home-design software for builders and remodelers. You draw a floor plan or start from an existing plan, then produce photoreal interior and exterior renderings. The comparison page lists plans from $129 a month and a Personal plan at $139 per project. A free plan covers one project.
pricingNotes: Plans are listed from $129 per month. Personal is a one-time $139 per project. A free plan covers one project.
bestFor: A builder who wants photoreal interior and exterior renderings from a house plan
A remodel presentation with a plan and a picture
notIdealFor: A game-style 3D asset from a text prompt
strength: Cedreo produces photoreal interior and exterior renderings from a house plan you draw or upload.
weakness: Paid plans are listed from $129 per month, with a one-project Personal option at $139.

useCaseFit.floor-plan-rendering: Produces photoreal interior and exterior renderings from a house plan.
